original_test_intent: Stress the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe link with exactly 10,000 deliberate retrain transactions and prove each transaction restores the endpoint at the approved generation and width without new PCIe, GPU, host, or platform errors.
original_method: Approve and pin the retrain primitive and exact link hierarchy; baseline topology, negotiated state, counters, and health; issue one numbered retrain at a time; durably record request, LTSSM progression, settled generation/width/deadline, enumeration continuity, and error deltas before permitting the next transaction; stop at first anomaly and recover only through the approved out-of-band path.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE approves retrain semantics, hierarchy, expected trajectory, and service impact; an operator isolates the SUT, watches out-of-band state, and owns recovery if the endpoint or host fails to return.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual retrain tool and configuration
Retrain primitive, expected LTSSM path, generation, width, enumeration, transient, and timing rules
10,000-transaction count, durable checkpoint/storage, error-delta, abort, final-state, and recovery policy
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production SUT and explicit approval for 10,000 retrains
No unsaved workload and verified out-of-band console/recovery
Bind every operation to the approved link hierarchy
Stop on failed/late retrain, missing endpoint, downtraining, unexpected sibling effect, new AER, GPU/host reset, thermal/power anomaly, tool fault, or evidence gap
Do not clear evidence, force recovery, or retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Validate target identity, primitive, baseline, interlocks, and ledger
Run only the approved retrain operation
Commit each complete retrain result before issuing the next
Correlate link, enumeration, error, GPU, host, and platform health
Do not infer targets, continue after evidence loss, retry a failure, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve retrain primitive, complete path scope, and 10,000-transaction risk
Review the complete ledger and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It names the appropriate vendor tool family but supplies no exact retrain command/configuration and a final lspci/dmesg sweep cannot prove 10,000 independently successful retrains.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned retrain primitive with an atomic monotonic ledger and a hard interlock preventing transaction N+1 until N's request, LTSSM completion, enumeration, generation/width, deadline, and error results are durable.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: LTSSM, exactly 10,000 PCIe retrains, successful no-error acceptance, no bundle, and 60/2880-minute allocation remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each retrain as an independently evidenced link-state transaction with durable topology, timing, negotiated-state, and error results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines the retrain primitive, target scope, completion contract, evidence durability, first-fault handling, and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final healthy link cannot reveal omitted transactions, transient failures, earlier downtraining, retrain timeouts, or recovered AER events.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong hierarchy or uncontrolled retrain storm can disrupt GPUs or sibling devices, reset the host, overflow evidence, or strand the endpoint.

project_override_considerations: Do not count setup actions, retries, incomplete retrains, or tool restarts as successful transactions. A compressed checkpoint format is acceptable only when it is lossless, gap-detecting, and preserves first-fault chronology.
expected_evidence: Pinned tool/configuration plus full target and sibling topology
Monotonic 1-10000 lossless ledger with timestamps and complete transaction status
First-fault recovery artifact or clean final endpoint/link/host state, followed by engineer verdict

review_improvement: Converts a generic high-count loop into a gap-detecting, first-fault-interlocked transaction soak without reducing the original 10,000-retrain coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A retrain may preserve enumeration while renegotiating speed, width, equalization, and LTSSM state, so endpoint presence alone is not proof of success. Transaction N is complete only when the intended link follows the approved retrain path, settles within deadline at the required generation and width, and produces no unacceptable error or platform-health delta. Because transient failures can disappear from the final state, durable commit-before-next-transaction evidence and immediate inhibition on first fault are necessary for both coverage and safety.
